g.text: Pull-ups, fail-safe pull-downs and local decoupling. Pin-explicit boxes; resistor/capacitor values identify passive function.

g.desc: Pull-ups, fail-safe pull-downs and local decoupling. Pin-explicit boxes; resistor/capacitor values identify passive function.

g.text: V3P3 from FPGA board only; V5_HOST from host or isolated fixture supply. Common GND. Never parallel module regulator outputs.

g.desc: V3P3 from FPGA board only; V5_HOST from host or isolated fixture supply. Common GND. Never parallel module regulator outputs.

g.text: X2 common contacts assigned from manual. J11 IRQ patch OPEN by default. JP1 open = disarmed. Host footprint pending.

g.desc: X2 common contacts assigned from manual. J11 IRQ patch OPEN by default. JP1 open = disarmed. Host footprint pending.

g.text: Pico1715 buffered bench adapter \u2014 rev B / NOT MACHINE-QUALIFIED

g.desc: Pico1715 buffered bench adapter \u2014 rev B / NOT MACHINE-QUALIFIED

g.text: WAIT/INT pull-ups belong to the host/fixture. U9 is open-drain. C1-C11: one 100 nF per IC; place at supply pins.

g.desc: WAIT/INT pull-ups belong to the host/fixture. U9 is open-drain. C1-C11: one 100 nF per IC; place at supply pins.
